subject: Government
subTopic: In democratic system legal sovereignty shouldn't be unquestionable
question: In a democratic system _______
explanation: In democracy legal sovereignty is not absolute; popular sovereignty checks it.
proTip: Democratic system = legal sovereignty shouldn't be unquestionable.

subject: Government
subTopic: Sovereignty thriving on legitimacy within people's mandate
question: That type of sovereignty that thrives on legitimacy is__________
options: vested on any form of government
explanation: Sovereignty that thrives on legitimacy is political/popular sovereignty within people's mandate.
proTip: Legitimacy sovereignty = within people's mandate.

subject: Government
subTopic: Right to seek redress means right to seek appeal under another judgement
question: The right of a citizen to seek redress means the right to________
options: seek an appeal under another judgement
explanation: Redress means seeking appeal/review under another judgement.
proTip: Seek redress = seek appeal under another judgement.

subject: Government
subTopic: Order compelling lower court to perform - writ of mandamus
question: An order compelling a lower court or public corporation to perform in accordance with legitimacy is called_________
explanation: Mandamus compels lower court/public body to perform duty.
proTip: Compel lower court to perform = mandamus.

subject: Government
subTopic: Form with slogan ruling of the best - aristocracy
question: A form of government which has its slogan to be 'ruling of the best' is__________
explanation: Aristocracy means ruling of the best.
proTip: Ruling of best = aristocracy.

subject: Government
topic: Structure and Workings of Nigerian Federalism
subTopic: Deconcentration of power means setting strategies for subsidiary territories by putting recognized personnel
question: Deconcentration of power means the_______
options: sharing of powers among tiers of government
creation of semi-autonomous units to govern other parts of a state
process of setting strategies or policies for the subsidiary territories in the state by putting recognized personnel in place
act of delegating powers and authority to component units that exist in a state
explanation: Deconcentration is administrative delegation setting policies for subsidiary territories via appointed personnel.
proTip: Deconcentration = setting strategies for subsidiary territories with personnel.

subject: Government
subTopic: Independence of judiciary means disabling executive/legislative influence on judicial decision
question: The concept of the independence of the judiciary means that________
options: The judiciary must not attempt to meddle into legislative and executive affairs
The powers of the courts can not be subjected of executive re-assessment
The sanctity of the office of the Judges and Justices must be preserved without prejudice
All means of legislative or executive influence on judicial decision making must be disabled
explanation: Independence of judiciary means no executive/legislative influence on judicial decisions.
proTip: Independence judiciary = disable executive/legislative influence.

subject: Government
subTopic: Political party serves as platform upon which rights and liberties can be attained
question: The political party serves as________
options: A platform upon which the rights and liberties of the people can be attained
The group aggregating the interest of all in the state
A platform for rebelling against military rule
explanation: Party serves as platform for attaining rights and liberties.
proTip: Party serves = platform for rights and liberties.

subject: Government
subTopic: Party has national outlook if membership cuts across ethnic boundaries
question: A party can be said to have national outlook if________
options: it is ethnic based but has branches all over the state
its membership cut across ethnic boundaries
it is registered by the electoral commission as a national party
it is headed by individuals who are famous within and without the country
explanation: National outlook means membership across ethnic boundaries.
proTip: National outlook = membership cuts across ethnic boundaries.

subject: Government
subTopic: Argumentation, negotiation, deliberation begins at second reading
question: Argumentation, negotiation and deliberation on the subject matter of a bill begins at the_______
explanation: Second reading is stage for debate on general principles of bill.
proTip: Deliberation on bill begins = second reading.

subject: Government
subTopic: Vote of no confidence means disapproval with dismissal in effect ministers and head
question: A vote of no confidence means______
options: the same as impeachment in a presidential system
the ability of the head of state to dissolve the parliament when collective responsibility fails to hold
the act of showing disapproval to the prime minister having breached the collective responsibility doctrine
the disapproval with dismissal in effect, the ministers and its head
explanation: Vote of no confidence leads to dismissal of ministers and PM.
proTip: Vote of no confidence = disapproval with dismissal of ministers and head.

subject: Government
subTopic: Cabinet reshuffle takes place when dissolution is held? Key says B dissolution
question: A cabinet re-shuffle takes place......
options: only when a motion of no confidence is passed
when prorogation and collective responsibility have their way
when the shadow cabinet fails in its effectiveness
explanation: Per key B says when dissolution is held, though reshuffle is PM reassigning portfolios.
proTip: Per this paper, reshuffle = when dissolution is held.

subject: Government
subTopic: Popular political participation means aggregate efforts actively involving all aspects
question: Popular political participation means________
options: having majority of the people partaking in politics
having a good number of voters in the electoral process
the aggregate efforts of more than half of the citizens to partake in public debate and politics
the sum total of all activities exerted by the majority with enthusiasm actively involving in all aspects of their political sphere
explanation: Popular participation is total activities of majority enthusiastically involving in political sphere.
proTip: Popular participation = sum total activities actively involving all aspects.

subject: Government
subTopic: Area electing members called constituency
question: The area from which one or more members or representatives are elected in public offices is called the electoral ........
explanation: Constituency is electoral area electing representative(s).
proTip: Electoral area electing = constituency.

subject: Government
subTopic: Citizenship by naturalization is act of non-citizen satisfying constitutional criteria becoming legal member
question: Citizenship by naturalization________
options: is the same as citizenship by marriage and registration
refers to the process of attaining citizenship through honorary means
is the act of a non-citizen having satisfied the constitutional criteria becoming a legal member of a state
is the medium by which an alien through the judiciary receives certification and attains citizenship by birth
explanation: Naturalization: non-citizen meets criteria becomes legal member.
proTip: Naturalization = non-citizen satisfies criteria becomes member.

subject: Government
subTopic: Last measure pressure groups issuing condition within stipulated time - ultimatum
question: The last measure used by the pressure groups issuing a condition to be satisfied within a stipulated time is called_______
explanation: Ultimatum is final condition with deadline before action like strike.
proTip: Last measure with stipulated time = ultimatum.

subject: Government
subTopic: Party with only manifestoes without fulfilment - elitist party? Key says elitist? Actually B
question: Generally, a political party with only manifestoes without fulfilment is a/an _____
explanation: Per key B says elitist party with manifestoes without fulfilment.
proTip: Manifestoes without fulfilment = elitist party per key.

subject: Government
subTopic: Form of government organized by council of military officers - Military Junta
question: A form of government organized by a council of military officers is called______
explanation: Military Junta is council of military officers ruling.
proTip: Council of military officers = military junta.

subject: Government
subTopic: Non-stratified society pre-colonial Igbo where decisions by consensus
question: The non-stratified society in the pre-colonial era was that of the ........ where decisions were made________
explanation: Igbo non-stratified acephalous society decisions by consensus.
proTip: Non-stratified pre-colonial = Igbo by consensus.

subject: Government
subTopic: Hausa/Fulani heterogeneous adopted partial federal with deconcentration
question: The Hausa/Fulani Empire as a result of its heterogeneous population adopted_________
options: A unitary system where full concentration of power prevailed
A federal structure where powers were decentralized although autocratic
A quasi federal structure with devolution
A partial federal set up with deconcentration
explanation: Hausa/Fulani heterogeneous adopted partial federal with deconcentration via emirates.
proTip: Hausa/Fulani heterogeneous = partial federal with deconcentration.

subject: Government
topic: Structure and Workings of Nigerian Federalism
subTopic: Twelve states creation achievement of Gowon regime
question: Twelve States creation is a reknown achievement of the ... regime
explanation: Gowon created 12 states in 1967.
proTip: 12 states = Gowon.

subject: Government
subTopic: Basis of foreign policy during independence constitution era Afrocentric
question: The basis of the Nigerian foreign policy thrust particularly during the Independence Constitution era was ... in nature
explanation: Foreign policy at independence Afrocentric.
proTip: Independence foreign policy = Afrocentric.

subject: Government
subTopic: Brussels conference 1889/90 based on putting end to slave trade
question: The Brussel conference in 1889/90 was based on______
options: putting an end to slave trade
furthering the decision on colonialism as previously discussed in the Berlin conference
deciding on how to penetrate Africa for economic adventurism
explanation: Brussels conference 1889-90 aimed at ending slave trade, especially Arab slave trade.
proTip: Brussels 1889/90 = end slave trade.

subject: Government
subTopic: Lewis Samuel pure conquest and unequivocal exploitation - regressive imperialism
question: According to Lewis Samuel, 'is identified with pure conquest and unequivocal exploitation...'
explanation: Regressive imperialism identified with pure conquest and exploitation.
proTip: Pure conquest exploitation = regressive imperialism.

subject: Government
subTopic: Major defect Nigerian council unrepresentative
question: One of the major defects of the Nigerian council which necessitated its replacement was that....
options: the meetings of the council were poorly attended
the council could only make law for the southern protectorate
the executive council was powerful than its
explanation: Nigerian Council 1914 unrepresentative, defect leading to Clifford Constitution.
proTip: Nigerian council defect = unrepresentative.

subject: Government
subTopic: Important provision 1946 constitution conceived federalism for Nigeria
question: An important provision of the 1946 constitution was that it ........
options: introduced official majority in the legislative council for the 1st time
for the 1st time, introduced the office of the head of government at the regional level
explanation: Richards 1946 conceived federalism by dividing into 3 regions.
proTip: 1946 provision = conceived federalism.

subject: Government
subTopic: All-Nigerian constitutional conference 1950 all unofficial members participated
question: In the all-Nigerian constitutional conference of 1950________
options: all official members of the legislative council participated
it was resolved that the Nigerians federation be organized on ethnic basis
it was concluded that a quasi-federal structure should be developed for colonial Nigeria
all unofficial members of the legislative council participated
explanation: Ibadan conference 1950 had all unofficial members participating.
proTip: 1950 all-Nigerian conference = all unofficial members participated.

subject: Government
subTopic: Implementations of target programmes primary duty of Civil Service part of Public Service
question: Implementations of the target programmes of the government is the primary duty of the _____ a part of the _____
explanation: Civil Service implements programmes, part of Public Service.
proTip: Implementation = Civil Service, part of Public Service.

subject: Government
subTopic: Most recent target plans UN - Sustainable Development Goals
question: The most recent target plans and agenda of the United Nations are known as the______
explanation: SDGs 2015-2030 replaced MDGs.
proTip: Recent UN target = SDGs.

subject: Government
subTopic: Federal judge under 1963 constitution removed by 2/3 majority National Assembly

explanation: 1963 constitution removal by 2/3 majority of National Assembly.
proTip: 1963 federal judge removal = 2/3 National Assembly.
